navigation.pagination: REST API (subsite wp-json/wp/v2/pages, per_page=100) with wp-sitemap.xml fallback
navigation.coverage: Volumes 106 (2017-18) through 114 (2025-26); 302 article pages in the subsite page sitemap as of 2026-08-28. Nothing before volume 106 is online — /in-print/volume-105/ is a masthead page, volume-100 is 404. Pre-2018 backfile is not available here.
navigation.notes: law.georgetown.edu is a WordPress MULTISITE hosting the whole law school plus every student journal. Each journal is a subsite mounted on the first path segment, with its OWN wp-json and wp-sitemap.xml (the origin-level ones return law-school pages only, no journal articles). GeorgetownLawWPAdapter re-roots the REST/sitemap lanes at https://www.law.georgetown.edu/georgetown-law-journal and restricts same-origin PDFs to that subsite's /wp-content/uploads/. GLJ Online (/georgetown-law-journal/submit/glj-online/) is a SEPARATE sub-publication and is deliberately out of scope for this seed -- give it its own seed. Seed is scoped to /in-print/, not to the host.
